info.title: CosmicForge Service Management API
info.description: API for dynamic service availability management with countdown timers, real-time status updates, and automated notifications. Allows admins to manage service downtime and users to check service availability.

tags.name: Public - Service Status
tags.description: Public endpoints for checking service availability (no authentication required)

tags.name: Admin - Service Management
tags.description: Admin endpoints for managing service availability (requires admin authentication)

tags.name: Admin - Service History
tags.description: Admin endpoints for viewing service status history and statistics

get.description: Retrieve all enabled services with their current status. This endpoint performs lazy reactivation - if a service's countdown has expired, it will be automatically reactivated.
Get the current status of a specific service by its key. Returns availability status, countdown timer (if applicable), and any downtime message.

data.name: Pharmacy
data.downtimeMessage: We are performing scheduled maintenance. Service will be back soon.

post.description: Check the status of multiple services at once. Useful for frontend apps that need to check all relevant services on startup.

example.message: serviceKeys must be a non-empty array

get.description: Simple boolean check to determine if a service is currently available. Returns true if service is active and enabled.
Retrieve all services including disabled ones. Returns full service details for admin dashboard.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled services in the response

post.description: Create a new service that can be managed for availability. The service key must be unique and will be automatically converted to lowercase with underscores.

get.description: Retrieve a single service by its ID with full details

put.description: Update service details (name, description, category, etc.). Does not change status - use the dedicated status endpoints for that.

delete.description: Soft delete a service. The service will be marked as deleted but not removed from the database.

post.description: Set a service to DOWN status with optional countdown timer. Can optionally specify a countdown end time for automatic reactivation, a reason for internal tracking, and a user-facing message. Notifications are sent to all users by default.

value.downtimeMessage: We are performing scheduled maintenance to improve your experience. Service will be back by 10:00 AM UTC.
Service is temporarily unavailable. We are working to restore it as soon as possible.

example.message: countdownEnd must be in the future

post.description: Override the service status to ACTIVE immediately. This will clear any countdown timer and send notifications to all users that the service is back online.

Extend the countdown timer for a service that is currently down. The new countdown end time must be later than the current one. Notifications are sent to inform users of the extended maintenance window.

example.reason: Additional testing required for data integrity

value.message: newCountdownEnd must be in the future
New countdown end must be later than current countdown end. Use shortenCountdown to make it earlier.
Can only extend countdown for services that are down

post.description: Shorten the countdown timer for a service that is currently down. The new countdown end time must be earlier than the current one. If the new time is in the past, the service will be immediately activated.

example.reason: Fixed the issue faster than expected

get.description: Retrieve the status change history for a specific service. Shows all status changes, countdown modifications, and who made the changes.
Retrieve status change history for all services. Useful for admin dashboard to see recent activity across all services.
Retrieve downtime statistics for a specific service including total incidents, total downtime duration, and average downtime.

bearerAuth.description: JWT token for authentication. Required for all admin endpoints.

Whether to send 'service is back' notifications to users
